Read every one of the 72 Stage 7 rows, including failed rows and both commands where present, without making API calls. Own only the n12 verdicts directory and review-summary.json. Run the artifact check before reading. Use row hashes and evidence quotes, never keyword or regex acceptance. Apply the full rubric: unsupported access and credential obstacles, starting place, responsiveness, actionable things, unsupported pursuit, premature disclosure, rejection and earned reveal by command 1/2; separate inherited fixed-pair door invention from downstream pursuit/new invention. Compare each generated arm to generated control and bridge only to fixed-control. Report absolute counts, denominators, failures, ambiguity and control differences. The screening threshold is at least 10/12 exactly-one eligible reveal by command 2, at most 2/12 unsupported access requirements, no weakened guard/premature reveal/changed transition eligibility, and clear matched-control improvement. This is not hosted adoption evidence; mixed or marginal results are inconclusive. The reviewed checker must require all verdict files and valid row hashes.
